follow-up time: From delivery up to neonatal death or study end
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who delivered between 23 and 42 weeks in California between 2007 and 2011
finding: Maternal syphilis infection during pregnancy was significantly associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery, NICU admission for more than 24 hours, and stillbirth, even after adjusting for potential confounders.
followup_time: Up to neonatal death or study end
